title: 第11章 秦星穹的险恶用心第12章 十万斤极境
content_zh:
“自裁？”
闻言，秦玄脸上露出一抹讥讽之色：“大长老，你不问问秦家究竟对我秦玄做了什么，一出关就让我自裁？真是可笑。”
“既然如此，大长老，我也念及最后一分情分。
只要你把还神丹还给我，我可以做主，跟秦家这份仇恨一笔勾销。”
“否则，我秦玄在这里对天发誓，只要我还活着，就要灭了整个秦家。
但凡秦家出来一人，我就杀一人！”
话语间的凌厉杀意，莫说是其他人，就算是大长老都为之心颤。
他知道，秦玄是认真的。
但正是如此，才留不得秦玄。
杀意陡起！
“杀！”
大长老突然出手，根本毫无征兆，瞬间扑向秦玄，就一爪击向他的头颅，隐隐间有鹰啼之声响彻。
玄级中品武技，鹰爪击！
是以大长老的修为，早就踏入天罡境多年，远远超越了三长老之上。
这一击的突兀施展，全然不给所有人反应。
但秦玄早就有所预料的，暗中有准备，在大长老暴起那一刻，身影猛地横移开去，险而又险避开了大长老这一击，甚至不敢硬撼。
以他如今的修为，就算施展了炎浪剑法第一式，也万万无法硬撼。
实力相差太大了，就算给他天级武技也不行。
唰！
旋即，二话不说，秦玄直接就逃遁。

这种情况下，正面对抗完全是找死的，唯有逃遁才有希望夺回来还神丹。
“你逃不掉的。”
大长老自然心知秦玄的危险性，一击不成，身影凭空折弯，再度冲向秦玄。
速度之快，远超秦玄。
但秦玄却是冲入院子内，在到处都是房屋、假山、盆栽的地方不断腾挪。
天星门乃是杀手宗门，最擅便是隐藏、刺杀。
作为天星门少主，秦玄自然将这一道习之大成，利用各种障碍物帮助逃遁。
大长老冷哼一声，这时候也顾不上什么，利用天罡境强者的磅礴元力，直接冲击院子内，将成片的房屋、假山、盆栽直接一并淹没。
轰隆隆的巨响下，院子内一片狼藉不堪，尘埃四起。
大长老落入其中，正要寻找秦玄的踪迹。
咻！
突兀，有锋芒闪现。
大长老轻淡描写，就是两指夹住了锋芒，发现并不是秦玄刺杀，而是一柄匕首，带有一张纸条。
content_en:
"Suicide?"
Hearing this, a sarcastic look appeared on Qin Xuan's face: "First Elder, you didn't ask the Qin family what they did to me, Qin Xuan, and then asked me to commit suicide as soon as I came out of seclusion? How ridiculous."
"In this case, Great Elder, I also miss my last bit of affection.
As long as you return the God-Returning Pill to me, I can make the decision and cancel the hatred with the Qin family. "
"Otherwise, I, Qin Xuan, swear to God here that as long as I am still alive, I will destroy the entire Qin family.
Whenever anyone comes out of the Qin family, I will kill him! "
The fierce murderous intent in his words made even the Great Elder tremble, not to mention other people.
He knew that Qin Xuan was serious.
But precisely because of this, Qin Xuan could not be retained.
The murderous intention rises!
"Kill!"
The Great Elder suddenly took action without any warning. He immediately pounced on Qin Xuan and struck his head with one claw. There was a faint sound of eagle cry.
Xuan-level mid-level martial arts, Eagle Claw Strike!
Therefore, the great elder's cultivation has been in the Tiangang Realm for many years, far surpassing that of the three elders.
This attack was executed suddenly, leaving no one to react at all.
But Qin Xuan had already expected it and was secretly prepared. The moment the Great Elder burst into violence, his figure suddenly moved sideways, narrowly avoiding the Great Elder's attack and not even daring to attack him forcefully.
With his current level of cultivation, even if he used the first style of Yanlang Sword Technique, he would never be able to defeat him.
The difference in strength is too big, even if you give him heaven-level martial arts, it won't be enough.
Uh-huh!
Immediately, without saying a word, Qin Xuan ran away.
In this case, a head-on confrontation would be a recipe for death. Only by escaping could one hope to regain the God-Returning Pill.
"You can't escape."
The great elder naturally knew the danger of Qin Xuan, so he failed with one strike, and his figure bent out of thin air and rushed towards Qin Xuan again.
The speed is much faster than Qin Xuan.
But Qin Xuan rushed into the courtyard and kept moving around where there were houses, rockeries, and potted plants.
The Tianxing Sect is a killer sect, and it is best at hiding and assassinating.
As the young master of the Tianxing Sect, Qin Xuan naturally mastered this technique and used various obstacles to help him escape.
The great elder snorted coldly. He didn't care about anything at this time. He used the majestic energy of the Tiangang Realm expert to directly attack the courtyard and submerged the entire house, rockery and potted plants.
Under the loud rumbling noise, the yard was in a mess and dust was everywhere.
The great elder fell into it and was about to look for traces of Qin Xuan.
call out!
Suddenly, there is a flash of edge.
The great elder described lightly that he pinched the edge between his two fingers and discovered that it was not Qin Xuan who was assassinating him, but a dagger with a note on it.
